mermaid:
flowchart LR
    SH["Shopper's bank or card"] -->|"1 authorization"| PSP["The PSP"]
    PSP -->|"result by webhook"| ORD["The order record"]
    ORD -->|"2 capture on shipment"| PSP
    NET["Card scheme or bank network"] -->|"3 settlement"| PSP
    PSP -->|"4 payout, net of fees"| BANK["Merchant's bank account"]
    PSP -->|"payout report"| ERP["The ERP"]
    BANK -->|"bank statement"| ERP
    RP["The returns portal"] -->|"refund request with return id"| ORD
    ORD -->|"refund"| PSP

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Pending
    Pending --> Authorized: card approved, money held
    Pending --> Paid: iDEAL or other instant method approved
    Pending --> Failed: declined, abandoned or session expired
    Authorized --> Paid: captured on shipment
    Authorized --> Canceled: released, or expired before capture
    Paid --> PartlyRefunded: partial refund succeeded
    Paid --> Refunded: full refund succeeded
    PartlyRefunded --> Refunded: remaining amount refunded
    Paid --> Disputed: chargeback opened
    Disputed --> Paid: chargeback reversed
    Disputed --> Refunded: chargeback lost

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Customer
    participant SUP as Support console at the PSP
    participant RP as The returns portal
    participant PL as The platform
    participant PSP as The PSP
    participant ERP as The ERP
    C->>SUP: Parcel delivered to Duiven, where is my refund
    SUP->>PSP: Manual refund 199 euro for the order
    PSP-->>ERP: Refund line in the daily report
    RP->>RP: Inspection passed, grade resellable
    RP->>PL: Refund 199 euro with the return id
    PL->>PSP: Refund 199 euro for the order, no return key
    PSP-->>PL: Refund webhook, success
    PSP-->>ERP: Second refund line in the daily report
    ERP->>ERP: Month end, two credits for one order
